controles.affirmation: HOOK : "A. O. Smith a tire en totalite un nouveau pret a terme de 470 M$ en janvier 2026 POUR CONTINUER A RACHETER DES ACTIONS ET VERSER SON DIVIDENDE" (repris par le titre "Rachats d'actions finances par la dette")
controles.verbatim_source: On January 5, 2026, the Company entered into an agreement for a new three-year, $470 million term loan with a group of eight banks. The Company borrowed the full available amount on January 5, 2026, and used the proceeds to finance the purchase of Leonard Valve. (10-Q T2 2026) / "the acquisition of Leonard Valve for $470 million. The acquisition was funded under a new three-year, $470 million term loan" / flux d'investissement : "Acquisition of business (470.0)"
controles.correction_proposee: Le pret a terme de 470 M$ a finance l'ACQUISITION de Leonard Valve (closing le 6 janvier 2026), pas les rachats d'actions ni le dividende. Reecrire le hook et le titre : "Le levier triple pour financer une acquisition de 470 M$, pendant que les rachats d'actions se poursuivent a 111,1 M$ sur le trimestre". GRAVE : la preuve citee tronque la phrase source exactement avant "and used the proceeds to finance the purchase of Leonard Valve", ce qui supprime le fait contradictoire. L'ATT ne mentionne nulle part l'acquisition de Leonard Valve.

controles.affirmation: Conformite aux clauses bancaires au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: The Company was in compliance with the covenants as of June 30, 2026.

controles.affirmation: 111,1 M$ de rachats d'actions et 49,6 M$ de dividendes sur le trimestre
controles.verbatim_source: Shares repurchased (111.1) (T2 2026) ; Dividends paid (99.8) sur six mois
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune (49,6 M$ = solde trimestriel coherent avec les 99,8 M$ semestriels).

controles.affirmation: Levier : dette brute 637,5 M$ (+110% sur un an), dette nette 456,2 M$ (+263,5%)
controles.verbatim_source: Long-term debt 598.0 (vs 112.7 au 31/12/2025) ; Cash and cash equivalents $181.3 ; "Our leverage... was 25.7 percent at June 30, 2026, compared with 7.7 percent at December 31, 2025. Our total debt increased by $482.5 million in the first six months of 2026."
controles.correction_proposee: Chiffres coherents ; en revanche la CAUSE indiquee (rachats/dividende) est fausse, cf. controle n1.

controles.affirmation: Prevision BPA dilue resserree de 3,60-3,90 $ a 3,60-3,75 $ ; BPA ajuste de 3,70-4,00 $ a 3,70-3,85 $ ; croissance des ventes de 2-4% a 2-3%
controles.verbatim_source: We have narrowed our full year sales growth outlook from our prior guidance of an increase of between two and four percent to an increase of between two and three percent. We have also narrowed our full-year diluted EPS to be between $3.60 and $3.75 from our prior guidance of between $3.60 and $3.90, and adjusted EPS to be between $3.70 and $3.85 from our prior guidance of between $3.70 and $4.00, reflecting persistent softness in the residential water heater industry volumes in North America.

controles.affirmation: Plan de restructuration d'environ 20 M$ net (avril 2026) ; 22,6 M$ de charges au T2 2026 dont 12,4 M$ de depreciations non monetaires
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2026, the Company approved and announced a restructuring plan in its water treatment business within the North America segment for approximately $20 million, net of anticipated proceeds... ; The Company recognized $22.6 million of restructuring and impairment expenses during the quarter ended June 30, 2026... $2.8 million in severance costs, $7.4 million of other restructuring expenses, and asset impairments of $12.4 million.

controles.affirmation: Ventes tierces en Chine -20,7% (28% en devise locale) ; baisse a deux chiffres bas attendue sur 2026 ; evaluation strategique toujours en cours ; Chine = 15% des ventes (152,4 sur 1 004,3 M$)
controles.verbatim_source: China third-party sales declined 28 percent in local currency in the second quarter of 2026 due to continued challenging market conditions including the cessation of the government appliance subsidy programs ; Rest of World China $152.4 vs $192.3 ; "In 2025, we initiated an assessment of strategic opportunities for our China business... The assessment is ongoing." ; "Our sales in the second quarter of 2026 were $1,004.3 million"
controles.correction_proposee: Detail : la source ecrit "subsidy programS" au pluriel, l'ATT cite le singulier. Sans consequence.

controles.affirmation: La prevision exclut explicitement l'impact des recents changements de politique tarifaire
controles.verbatim_source: Our guidance excludes the impacts from potential future acquisitions, any potential outcomes of the assessment of the China business and and the potential impact of recently announced changes in tariff policy.
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune. Nuance : l'ATT en deduit que "la direction ne parvient pas encore a le chiffrer" ; c'est une interpretation, pas un propos du document.

controles.affirmation: BPA dilue 0,91 $ (-15%) ; resultat net 124,9 M$ contre 152,2 M$ (-17,9%)
controles.verbatim_source: Diluted Net Earnings Per Share of Common Stock $0.91 $1.07 ; Net Earnings $124.9 $152.2
